review: Independent static native symbolic-HEAD repair protocol re-review
scope: Narrow production correction from097c00f plus prior guarded snapshot/relay/retention scope and preserved refs-only diagnostic evidence. No changed-production compilation/runtime, recording execution, CI or whole-feature approval by reviewer.
static_assessment: Native transaction now update HEAD new old, without option no-deref, explicit branch update or duplicate symref-verify. Git dereferences HEAD and owns the native HEAD/referent operation; this avoids the duplicate implicit HEAD registration that safely refused the previous scratch proof.

Branch identity remains bound into private script, proof and recovery metadata despite removing the unused Hook branch field. A pre-lock same-tip HEAD switch cannot qualify solely through matching OIDs: prepared stdin must contain exactly one intended branch/old/new tuple, with no other/extra fields, and symbolic HEAD must match before the original hook runs.

Symbolic HEAD and old OID are checked again after the original prepared hook, before raw index/dependency/stat-cold work checks and checkout. Existing checks after checkout and after original committed hook remain unchanged.

Scratch capability proof uses this same native HEAD update and requires exact branch-only native prepared input, prepared/committed ACKs and actual final HEAD target/new OID. Unsupported versions/backends still refuse before user-ref dispatch.

Immutable saved-index/dependency selection, Practice/profile routing, original hook argv/stdin/config restoration, exact user ACKs, local uncertainty retention and remote fail-closed entry points remain intact.
The earlier490a9e7 HookScript grouping preserves identical values and immediately destructures them; inspection found no separate protocol behavior in that compiler-only fix.

Added owned fixture module is cfg(test,unix); its real protocol entry is ignored by default and requires explicit case/root selection in an env-cleared child. No production PID selector, signal controller or remote runner is introduced.

inspected_prior_evidence.gate1: All five preserved recording log hashes match490a9e7 results. These are prior-source checks; they must be repeated for corrected production source.
inspected_prior_evidence.initial_gate2: Previous actual scratch transaction safely refused duplicate HEAD registration before user mutation; this is failure evidence for the prior protocol, not success evidence for this correction.
inspected_prior_evidence.native_diagnostics: Seven refs-only cases preserved at097c00f; all95 per-file hashes match results.json. Four files/reftable x sha1/sha256 native updates succeeded. Files-backend nested symbolic switch and detach refused on owned HEAD.lock. Pre-lock same-tip other-branch switch refused with identical complete before/after snapshots. Every case preserves index/work bytes and recorded modes.
inspected_prior_evidence.diagnostic_limit: Refs-only diagnostics do not execute repaired checkout or the changed production wrapper. Nested HEAD-lock cases are files-backend diagnostics; do not generalize literal HEAD.lock filenames to reftable locking.

required_recording_repeat.decision: Root may release recording-only checks after compiler/binary/source binding and preserved plan. No real protocol execution until root accepts these results.
required_recording_repeat.new_guard_cases: Also record wrong target, wrong old/new OIDs, duplicate/extra input and already-wrong symbolic HEAD. Assert refusal before any original prepared-hook invocation or checkout. These can be test-only variants using supplied recording Git, owned temp files and no real repository/ref transaction.
required_recording_repeat.preservation: Save exact compiled-source/binary/log hashes and counts; commit/push/remoteverify before next gate. Any compiler-only/test-only followup must be preserved and explicitly rebound; any production protocol change needs static re-review.

owned_gate2_release_conditions.decision: After recording repeat passes and root accepts evidence, root may authorize the following owned local cases under the previously accepted containment conditions, without a new broad planning loop.
owned_gate2_release_conditions.containment: Explicit selected ignored test only; exclusive new temp root, env_clear/private HOME/XDG/Git config/TMPDIR, explicit recorded Git executable/version/hash, no user keys/config/remotes/live hosts. Use existing approved bounded owned-child helper only, with preserved fixture source/plan before execution; no new watchdog/PID selectors/signals and no removal of unrelated locks.
cases: Actual production scratch proof plus Hook execute success across files/reftable x sha1/sha256 claimed supported; verify final expected branch/symbolic HEAD/index/worktree, original hook argv/stdin/config and all nonempty exact ACKs. A backend refusal remains safe-refusal evidence, not repair success.
Actual changed-production pre-lock same-tip other-branch and detached HEAD cases must refuse before original prepared hook/checkout and preserve external HEAD plus both refs/index/worktree.

Original prepared hook attempts to switch/detach HEAD must be blocked by the actual native transaction lock or refused with preserved edits, before checkout. For reftable use backend-appropriate lock/refusal evidence rather than asserting a files-backend HEAD.lock pathname.
Held target ref lock, original policy veto, index replacement and working-byte mutation; snapshots must prove refusal/preserved external changes and no automatic rollback.

Saved split-index/dependency rotation and missing dependency cases must establish that real Git GIT_INDEX_FILE resolves the immutable saved index's dependency; retain a coherent pair after later failure.

Checkout failure, original committed-hook failure and bounded timeout must retain actionable owned index/dependency/old-new IDs/update/ACK evidence. Record actual committed or uncommitted ref outcome; retain concurrent edits and do not restore automatically.
Unsupported old Git, missing capability/ACK and backend refusal before user mutation; successful full scan/fix and existing undo journal integration remain necessary beyond direct Hook cases.
owned_gate2_release_conditions.acceptance: Record exact before/after refs, symbolic HEAD, index/dependency/work bytes and modes, process outcome, original relay records and retained evidence. Commit/push/verify each completed validation unit. Root assesses failures before broader feature tests.

limits: Status JSON retains legacy top-level head/tree fields; review binds immutable Git candidate/tree and checked transaction SHA above, plus its latest_head fields. Do not treat old application gates as results on this production correction.
No reviewer test/compile/protocol execution or CI access; source is STATIC only.
Remote automatic repair remains OPEN/interim fail-closed. Existing completion counters do not establish per-request mutation dispatch/outcome ownership.
Default-port/auth retry/deletion undo-redo/full-feature and final combined local gates/adversarial review remain open. No final feature PASS or PR approval.
